Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer incorrectly identified Simone de Beauvoir as the spouse of Alain Robbe-Grillet based on unreliable or inaccurate search results. Simone de Beauvoir is a well-known French philosopher and writer, but she was never married to Alain Robbe-Grillet. The correct spouse of Alain Robbe-Grillet is Catherine Robbe-Grillet. The error occurred because WebSurfer failed to verify the accuracy of the information presented in the search results or cross-check it with more authoritative sources.
